name: AI-NTIVIR v1.0.5 BETA
body:
## AI-NTIVIR (AI Antivirus) BETA - v1.0.5

Windows 10/11 installer with:
- Real-time protection with automatic quarantine (tested with EICAR)
- 559,456-entry signature database (downloaded automatically during install)
- Enhanced Quick Scan, Custom and Full scans
- System tray menu, autostart, dashboard

## Fixes in this release
- Disabled degenerate AI scoring (constant score for all files)
- Self-exclusion: the app no longer flags its own installer
- Heuristic score capped at 0.6 - only signature hits can trigger quarantine
- Tray menu fixed, autostart added, ProgramData-writable runtime data

## Download
The signed installer (AI-NTIVIR-Setup-1.0.5.signed.exe) is attached below.

Code signing: this project uses the SignPath Foundation for code signing (https://signpath.org).

Privacy policy: https://github.com/krapulax915/ai-ntivir/blob/main/PRIVACY.md
Source code (MIT): https://github.com/krapulax915/ai-ntivir
